mechanism: Cached GetValue currently calls ProbeValue, including activity lookup, and hot accessor methods cross call boundaries.
prediction: A direct value-only cached path with a separate cold miss method reduces coherent read ns/op without changing inactive values or invalidation.
outcome: Value-only reads improved; individual launch variability remains in raw data.

mechanism: Cached writes refresh their leaf after tree.SetValueOn, repeating root and internal dictionary lookups on each leaf transition.
prediction: Reusing resolved leaf/internal nodes on misses reduces coherent write ns/op, preserving no-op tile writes and topology invalidation.
outcome: A single resolution improved existing-leaf writes.

mechanism: A single-leaf cache misses every eight sequential coordinates and repeats root/upper/lower hash lookups.
prediction: A version-validated lower/upper node cache reduces transition cost under coherent and randomized workloads without returning detached nodes.
outcome: Internal-node caches helped the early design; H24 removed them after secondary caching covered the working set.

mechanism: Tier 1 Cached checks leaf origin with three serial component comparisons; the same three bits define leaf membership.
prediction: One combined XOR/OR/mask containment predicate reduces coherent hit-path branches with identical membership over signed Int32 coordinates.
outcome: The original aligned-comparison alternative regressed reads in the later cache regime.

mechanism: The coherent loop repeatedly revisits four Z-neighboring leaves within each X/Y leaf strip; a one-leaf cache still resolves every eight voxels.
prediction: A four-slot direct-mapped leaf cache used only on leaf misses eliminates repeated internal dictionary lookups while preserving full origin checks and clearing all slots on topology changes. Measure added per-accessor storage and random/sparse controls.
outcome: Four slots improved coherent access but regressed randomized reads; replaced by 64 slots.

mechanism: Optimized write caller still checks the leaf array length, dynamic NodeMask size, and mask array length for a coordinate offset already bounded to 0..511. Leaf buffers always contain 512 values and masks 8 words.
prediction: GC-tracked byref coordinate access with a private bounded leaf-mask path removes redundant checks and improves complete cached read/write loops. Retain public integer-index validation and verify buffer swapping, compacting GC, Bool and unmanaged record values.
outcome: Unchecked read/write accesses did not demonstrate repeatable benefit.

mechanism: Leaf resolution calls ProbeValue even when callers need only a leaf for writing or a value for reading; this performs unused value/activity loads on every leaf transition.
prediction: Return the resolved leaf and tile state separately; each caller performs only its required value/activity operation. Complete coherent reads/writes improve with identical missing/tile semantics.
outcome: General leaf-only resolution produced no repeatable gain in its tested regime.

mechanism: The managed leaf activity update follows LeafNode -> NodeMask -> word array, unlike native inline mask storage. Removing guards alone produced negligible write benefit and worse read timings.
prediction: Cache the immutable word-array identity in each leaf and use safe coordinate-indexed stores, retaining the NodeMask facade and checked integer API. One fewer dependent reference load improves cached writes; read path remains safe.
outcome: Safe direct mask-word alias had a modest write benefit; no independent percentage claim.

mechanism: The four-slot leaf cache adds a separate small array allocation and indexed miss lookup. Fixed inline storage can remove this object and known-range array checks.
prediction: A four-element InlineArray of managed leaf references reduces accessor allocation without weakening GC relocation or invalidation, and has no material cached-access regression.
outcome: Inline storage removes the separate cache-array allocation; speed changes alone were inconclusive.

mechanism: Four direct-mapped slots collide for randomized traversal over the 64-leaf working set, causing a repeatable 18% read regression versus the original library.
prediction: An inline 64-slot cache indexed by the low two leaf-coordinate bits per axis removes these collisions, improving random access and coherent transitions. Charge approximately 512 bytes of per-accessor cache storage; preserve full origin checks and invalidation.
outcome: 64 slots removed the observed random-access collision regression.

mechanism: SetValueOn unconditionally performs an activity-word read/modify/write even when all 64 voxels in the word are already active.
prediction: Skip the mask update when the word is ulong.MaxValue, retaining the value store and all sparse-word updates. Dense coherent/random writes improve; initial materialization and mixed-activity correctness remain unchanged.
outcome: Skipping already-saturated mask stores is a small local component of the final verified build.

mechanism: The hot GetValue/SetValueOn caller checks the nullable result of Cached after Cached has already checked the leaf, generating redundant hit-path tests and control-flow joins.
prediction: Express the leaf/version/containment hit condition directly in the hot methods and validate/clear stale caches in their cold miss helpers. This reduces hit-path control flow without omitting topology validation.
outcome: Direct nullable hit predicate did not improve the version-polled design.

mechanism: The hit predicate loads the cached leaf reference and then leaf.Origin before deciding membership. Native accessors keep the cache key alongside the node pointer.
prediction: Store the cached leaf origin in the accessor when resolving a leaf. Membership loads become independent of leaf dereferencing, shortening the hit-path dependency chain; all key updates must coincide with leaf replacement.
outcome: A separate cached origin did not improve complete callers.

mechanism: The combined XOR predicate was marginal in the earlier single-leaf regime. With a 64-slot cache the bottleneck is predominantly the seven-of-eight last-leaf hit path.
prediction: Retest original short-circuit aligned-coordinate comparisons in the materially changed 64-slot regime. Fewer unconditional ALU operations may improve coherent hits despite extra predictable branches.
outcome: Original short-circuit aligned comparisons were slower in the tested final-cache regime.

mechanism: Every cached operation reads the tree topology version through an additional reference and compares it. Native safe accessors are invalidated by the tree when topology changes.
prediction: Register accessors as ConditionalWeakTable keys and clear their caches at the existing InvalidateAccessors boundaries. Remove per-access version polling while retaining tree epochs for iterators/managers. Validate weak lifetime, concurrent accessor creation on frozen trees, all topology mutations and topology-churn allocation/time.
outcome: Weak-table callbacks improved hits but materially regressed topology churn; original lazy invalidation restored.

mechanism: After mutation-time invalidation, the hit condition no longer needs version polling. Cached still returns a nullable node and joins hit/miss control flow before the caller tests it again.
prediction: Retest direct hit conditions in the materially changed callback-invalidation regime; remove redundant nullable-result joins while retaining the cold resolver and tree-owned invalidation.
outcome: Direct callback-regime predicates did not improve callers.

mechanism: The revised write path now directly aliases activity words and skips saturated stores. Its remaining array guards differ from the earlier two-indirection NodeMask experiment.
prediction: Retest GC-tracked bounded byrefs for coordinate writes only in this changed layout; retain safe GetValue and checked public integer overloads. Benefit must justify unsafe maintenance and preserve compacting-GC/buffer-swap semantics.
outcome: Write-only bounded byrefs did not justify unsafe maintenance. Original incomplete run is preserved separately.

mechanism: Dense existing writes still load the activity-word array and read a saturated word on every voxel, although these words cannot change until a mask-clearing mutation.
prediction: Maintain a conservative eight-bit cache of saturated activity words. Dense writes skip mask access entirely; every operation that can clear activity resets the cache. Verify all mutation surfaces, partial-density controls, cloning, and compacting GC.
outcome: Per-leaf saturation metadata gave too little benefit for its invalidation burden.

mechanism: A last-leaf miss that hits the 64-slot cache still calls the non-inlined generic resolver and ProbeValue, then performs its real read/write. This extra call and unused activity/value work recurs every eight coherent voxels.
prediction: Inline a secondary-cache lookup into each cold accessor helper and perform the requested leaf operation directly; reserve full resolution for genuine cache misses. This removes one call boundary and unused probes without per-leaf metadata or unsafe indexing.
outcome: Direct secondary-cache operations removed a call and unused probing.

mechanism: The selected fast cached path improves coherent/random/partial accesses, but topology churn rises from 425 to 702 ns/op. ConditionalWeakTable invalidation creates enumerators on each structural event.
prediction: Replace weak-table storage with a lazily allocated, lock-protected list of weak accessor references; scan/cull without allocating during invalidation. Preserve concurrent construction and weak lifetime; reduce churn and registration costs while retaining identical cached hit code.
outcome: Weak-list invalidation reduced weak-table cost but retained unnecessary registry and mutation overhead.

mechanism: After allocation-free weak invalidation, structural writes still resolve a tile, then repeat resolution in tree.SetValueOn and again when populating the accessor cache.
prediction: Reuse the resolved tile value/activity for no-op detection; materialize once through TouchLeaf and cache the returned leaf directly. Preserve inherited values/activity and topology boundaries while reducing churn lookup work.
outcome: Reused materialization is retained with the callback-version check and append-only stamp refinement.

mechanism: Weak-list invalidation removes enumeration allocation but still adds registration, locking and full-cache clearing to structural mutations. The now-direct secondary-hit path is substantially faster than the path used when version polling was first compared.
prediction: Retest original lazy version polling in the changed direct-secondary regime. It may meet native cached throughput while avoiding weak registries and mutation-time cache clearing; preserve original lazy invalidation semantics and stamp newly materialized leaves.
outcome: Original lazy topology polling meets the target in the improved secondary-cache regime.

mechanism: The polled candidate clears its 64-slot cache on observing an external topology change, then clears it again after TouchLeaf. TouchLeaf itself only materializes nodes; it does not detach existing leaves.
prediction: After any value-equality callback, clear only if its topology version changed, then materialize and stamp the returned leaf. Retain already-valid references across append-only materialization. This removes redundant clearing while preserving the explicit reentrant-equality regression case.
outcome: Avoiding the redundant clear restored churn performance; reentrant equality regression passes.

mechanism: The 64-slot secondary cache now handles all warm accesses in the primary working set. Retained upper/lower node references are no longer needed there and can keep whole detached branches alive while an accessor is idle.
prediction: Use the canonical VdbTree.Probe only on genuine leaf-cache misses; remove internal-node cache fields and duplicated traversal. Preserve cached throughput and improve code/storage simplicity, while bounding detached-node retention to leaf entries.
outcome: Canonical full-tree probing on genuine misses simplifies code and bounds detached retention to leaf entries; final gates pass.
